annotations.title: Request execution of a prepared change

description: Step 2 of every change: submit one preview made by a prepare_* tool, exactly as stored. A preview works once, for 15 minutes, and is refused if the campaign changed meanwhile. The answer says whether it waits for a person (the default) or applies under the client's write policy. It cannot approve.

preview_id.description: The preview_id returned by a prepare_* tool.

name: execute_prepared_change
